```{r}
# ============================================================
# 去噪前预处理：病历整理、文本清理、病历选择及问卷匹配
#
# 精神检查处理：
#   先识别为独立栏目，再提取正文。
#   无论位于现病史之后还是其他栏目之后，均纳入分析文本。
#   按原文顺序合并，栏目标题不进入正文。
#
# 输出中的“现病史”列：
#   保存现病史与精神检查合并后的文本。
#
# 本阶段不执行问卷减1、反向计分和后续Python去噪。
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(lubridate)
  library(here)
  library(openxlsx)
})


# ==================== 1. 参数与路径 ====================

BASE_DIR <- here::here()
DATA_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "DATA")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "OUTPUT")
RAW_OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "data")

LOCAL_TZ <- "Asia/Shanghai"

USE_STANDALONE_DATES <- FALSE

MIN_AGE <- 7
MAX_AGE_EXCLUSIVE <- 19

PURE_DEP_LABELS <- c("抑郁状态", "抑郁障碍")


# ==================== 2. 基础函数 ====================

clean_id <- function(x) {
  na_if(str_trim(as.character(x)), "")
}

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("[\r\n\t\u3000]", " ") %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    na_if("")
}

has_text <- function(x) {
  !is.na(x) & str_squish(as.character(x)) != ""
}

keep_lines <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x) %>%
    str_replace_all("\r\n|\r", "\n") %>%
    str_replace_all("\u3000", " ")

  x[!has_text(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

normalize_sex <- function(x) {
  z <- str_to_lower(clean_text(x))

  case_when(
    z %in% c("男", "男性", "男孩", "男童", "m", "male") ~ "男",
    z %in% c("女", "女性", "女孩", "女童", "f", "female") ~ "女",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

parse_age <- function(x) {
  z <- clean_text(x)
  values <- unique(z)

  ages <- vapply(values, function(s) {
    if (is.na(s)) return(NA_real_)

    s <- str_remove_all(s, "[[:space:]]")

    if (str_detect(s, "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?$")) {
      ans <- as.numeric(s)

    } else if (
      str_detect(
        s,
        paste0(
          "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:周岁|岁)",
          "(?:\\d+(?:个)?月)?",
          "(?:\\d+(?:天|日))?$"
        )
      )
    ) {
      ans <- as.numeric(str_extract(s, "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?"))

    } else if (
      str_detect(s, "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:个)?月$")
    ) {
      ans <- as.numeric(
        str_extract(s, "^\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?")
      ) / 12

    } else {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    if (!is.finite(ans) || ans < 0 || ans > 120) {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    floor(ans)
  }, numeric(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  unname(ages[match(z, values)])
}

parse_local_time <- function(x, submit = FALSE) {
  z <- clean_text(x) %>%
    str_replace_all("年|月", "-") %>%
    str_remove_all("日")

  if (submit) {
    z <- str_replace_all(z, "\\s+CST(?:\\s+|$)", " ")
  }

  serial <- !is.na(z) &
    str_detect(z, "^\\d{5}(?:\\.\\d+)?$")

  out <- as.POSIXct(
    rep(NA_real_, length(z)),
    origin = "1970-01-01",
    tz = LOCAL_TZ
  )

  if (any(serial)) {
    n <- as.numeric(z[serial])
    d <- as.Date(floor(n), origin = "1899-12-30")

    out[serial] <- as.POSIXct(
      as.character(d),
      tz = LOCAL_TZ
    ) + round((n %% 1) * 86400)
  }

  idx <- which(!serial & !is.na(z))

  if (length(idx)) {
    out[idx] <- suppressWarnings(
      parse_date_time(
        z[idx],
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd", "a b d HMS Y"),
        tz = LOCAL_TZ,
        locale = "C",
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    )
  }

  out
}

parse_date <- function(x) {
  as.Date(parse_local_time(x), tz = LOCAL_TZ)
}

parse_submit_time <- function(x) {
  parse_local_time(x, submit = TRUE)
}

escape_regex <- function(s) {
  chars <- strsplit(s, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  special <- c(
    "\\", ".", "^", "$", "|", "?", "*", "+",
    "(", ")", "[", "]", "{", "}"
  )

  paste0(
    ifelse(chars %in% special, paste0("\\", chars), chars),
    collapse = ""
  )
}

label_regex <- function(label) {
  chars <- strsplit(label, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

  paste(
    vapply(chars, escape_regex, character(1)),
    collapse = "[ \\t]*"
  )
}

labels_pattern <- function(labels) {
  labels <- unique(labels)
  labels <- labels[order(nchar(labels), decreasing = TRUE)]

  paste(
    vapply(labels, label_regex, character(1)),
    collapse = "|"
  )
}


# ==================== 3. 病历栏目识别 ====================

mental_headers <- c(
  "精神检查结果",
  "精神状态检查",
  "精神科检查",
  "精神检查"
)

mental_pattern <- labels_pattern(mental_headers)

mental_title_pattern <- regex(
  paste0("(?:", mental_pattern, ")[ \\t]*[:：][ \\t]*")
)

mental_standalone_pattern <- regex(
  paste0("(?m)^[ \\t]*(?:", mental_pattern, ")[ \\t]*$")
)

assessment_headers <- c(
  "心理检查结果", "心理检查",
  "心理测试结果", "心理测试",
  "心理测验结果", "心理测验",
  "心理测评结果", "心理测评",
  "心理评估结果", "心理评估",
  "测评结果", "评估结果",
  "脑电生物点反馈", "脑电生物电反馈",
  "沙盘结果", "沙盘总结", "沙盘",
  "韦氏智力测评", "瑞文智力测评", "智力测评",
  "症状自评量表", "症状自评",
  "儿童行为量表", "注意力评估量表",
  "注意力诊断量表", "困难量表", "压力测评"
)

assessment_pattern <- labels_pattern(assessment_headers)

background_headers <- c(
  "既往史", "过敏史", "流行病学史", "个人史", "家族史"
)

section_headers <- unique(c(
  "陪诊人", "主诉", "现病史", "精神检查",
  background_headers,
  "体格检查", "专科查体", "专科检查", "辅助检查",
  assessment_headers,
  "诊断", "诊疗计划",
  "表格<诊断>内容", "表格<处置>内容",
  "医师签名", "就诊日期", "日期"
))

section_headers <- section_headers[
  order(nchar(section_headers), decreasing = TRUE)
]

header_rules <- lapply(section_headers, function(header) {
  h <- label_regex(header)

  boundary <- if (header %in% background_headers) {
    "([，,。；;])"
  } else {
    "([。；;])"
  }

  standalone_tail <- if (header %in% assessment_headers) {
    paste0(
      "[ \\t]*",
      "(?:(?:显示|提示|表明|发现|为)[ \\t]*[:：]?)?",
      "[ \\t]*$"
    )
  } else {
    "[ \\t]*$"
  }

  list(
    label = paste0(header, "："),

    line = regex(
      paste0("(?m)^[ \\t]*", h, "[ \\t]*[:：]")
    ),

    standalone = regex(
      paste0("(?m)^[ \\t]*", h, standalone_tail)
    ),

    inline = if (
      !header %in% c(assessment_headers, "日期", "就诊日期")
    ) {
      regex(
        paste0(boundary, "[ \\t]*", h, "[ \\t]*[:：]")
      )
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  )
})

section_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(?m)^(?:",
    paste(
      vapply(section_headers, escape_regex, character(1)),
      collapse = "|"
    ),
    ")："
  )
)

standardize_note <- function(x) {
  x <- keep_lines(x)

  # 修改：先保留精神检查的栏目边界，不再直接删掉标题。
  x <- str_replace_all(
    x, mental_title_pattern, "\n精神检查："
  )

  x <- str_replace_all(
    x, mental_standalone_pattern, "\n精神检查："
  )

  for (rule in header_rules) {
    x <- str_replace_all(x, rule$line, rule$label)
    x <- str_replace_all(x, rule$standalone, rule$label)

    if (!is.null(rule$inline)) {
      x <- str_replace_all(
        x,
        rule$inline,
        paste0("\\1\n", rule$label)
      )
    }
  }

  x
}

split_sections <- function(note_std) {
  empty <- data.frame(
    header = character(),
    text = character(),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  if (!has_text(note_std)) return(empty)

  loc <- str_locate_all(note_std, section_pattern)[[1]]

  if (!nrow(loc)) {
    return(data.frame(header = "正文", text = note_std))
  }

  starts <- loc[, 2] + 1L
  ends <- c(loc[-1, 1] - 1L, nchar(note_std))

  body <- rep("", nrow(loc))
  nonempty <- starts <= ends

  body[nonempty] <- str_sub(
    note_std,
    starts[nonempty],
    ends[nonempty]
  )

  result <- data.frame(
    header = str_remove(
      str_sub(note_std, loc[, 1], loc[, 2]),
      "：$"
    ),
    text = body
  )

  if (loc[1, 1] > 1) {
    result <- rbind(
      data.frame(
        header = "正文",
        text = str_sub(note_std, 1, loc[1, 1] - 1)
      ),
      result
    )
  }

  result
}


# ==================== 4. 新病历日期提取 ====================

extract_note_date <- function(x) {
  x <- keep_lines(x)

  date_re <- paste0(
    "\\d{4}[ \\t]*[-/.年][ \\t]*",
    "\\d{1,2}[ \\t]*[-/.月][ \\t]*\\d{1,2}日?"
  )

  explicit_pattern <- paste0(
    "(?m)^[ \\t]*(?:就[ \\t]*诊[ \\t]*)?",
    "日[ \\t]*期[ \\t]*[:：][ \\t]*(",
    date_re, ")"
  )

  values <- lapply(
    str_match_all(x, regex(explicit_pattern)),
    function(m) m[, 2]
  )

  if (USE_STANDALONE_DATES) {
    missing <- which(lengths(values) == 0L)

    values[missing] <- lapply(
      str_match_all(
        x[missing],
        regex(
          paste0("(?m)^[ \\t]*(", date_re, ")[ \\t]*$")
        )
      ),
      function(m) m[, 2]
    )
  }

  unique_values <- unique(unlist(values, use.names = FALSE))
  parsed <- parse_date(str_remove_all(unique_values, "[ \\t]"))

  days <- vapply(values, function(vals) {
    dates <- parsed[match(vals, unique_values)]
    good <- unique(dates[!is.na(dates)])

    if (length(good) == 1L && !anyNA(dates)) {
      as.numeric(good[1])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  }, numeric(1))

  as.Date(days, origin = "1970-01-01")
}


# ==================== 5. 行内心理测验清理 ====================

assessment_lead_pattern <- paste0(
  "(?:(?:当地|本院|外院)[ \\t]*|(?:在|于)?[ \\t]*",
  "[\\p{Han}A-Za-z0-9]{2,20}",
  "(?:医院|中心|门诊|诊所)[ \\t]*[:：]?[ \\t]*)?"
)

next_header_pattern <- labels_pattern(section_headers)

inline_assessment_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(^|[，,。；;！？!?\\n])",

    "([ \\t]*",
      assessment_lead_pattern,
      "(?:", assessment_pattern, ")",

      "[ \\t]*(?:结果[ \\t]*)?",
      "(?:[:：]|",
      "(?:显示|提示|表明|发现|为)[ \\t]*[:：]?)",
      "[ \\t]*",

      "[^。；;！？!?\\n]*?",
    ")",

    "(?=",
      "[，,]?[ \\t]*(?:", next_header_pattern, ")[ \\t]*[:：]",
      "|[。；;！？!?\\n]",
      "|$",
    ")"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

remove_inline_assessment <- function(x) {
  if (!has_text(x)) return(NA_character_)

  str_replace_all(
    x,
    inline_assessment_pattern,
    "\\1"
  )
}


# ==================== 6. 原有文本清理规则 ====================

bad_tail <- paste0(
  "多动冲动严重程度学习问题情绪问题品行自尊心",
  "厌学病程饮食睡眠共患病治疗过程"
)

diagnosis_leak_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(?:诊断(?:为)?\\s*)?",
    "(?:轻度|中度|重度|严重|非常严重)?\\s*",
    "(?:抑郁状态|抑郁障碍|抑郁发作|",
    "抑郁症(?!状)|焦虑抑郁症(?!状)|",
    "焦虑抑郁(?=\\s*(?:$|[，,。；;：:、])))"
  )
)

scale_core <- paste(
  c(
    "PHQ[-－]?9", "DASS[-－]?21",
    "SCARED", "DSRSC", "SAS", "SDS", "CDI", "DASS", "PHQ",
    "HAMD(?:[-－]?\\d+)?", "HAMA(?:[-－]?\\d+)?",
    "SCL[-－]?90", "Conners", "CBCL", "SDQ",
    "汉密尔顿(?:抑郁|焦虑)?(?:量表)?",
    "症状自评(?:量表)?", "儿童行为量表",
    "注意力评估量表", "注意力诊断量表",
    "困难量表", "压力测评", "艾森克人格(?:问卷)?",
    "韦氏(?:智力(?:测评|测试)?|测评|测试)",
    "瑞文(?:智力(?:测评|测试)?|测评|测试)"
  ),
  collapse = "|"
)

scale_score_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(?:", scale_core, ")",
    "\\s*[（(]?\\s*(?:总分|评分|得分|结果)?\\s*",
    "(?:为|[:：=])?\\s*",
    "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?![\\d.])",
    "(?!\\s*(?:分钟|分后|分前|小时|天|周|月|年|岁|次))",
    "\\s*分?\\s*[)）]?"
  ),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

scale_name_pattern <- regex(
  paste0("(?:", scale_core, ")"),
  ignore_case = TRUE
)

bare_score_pattern <- regex(
  paste0(
    "(^|[，,。；;\\n])[ \\t]*",
    "(?:焦虑|抑郁|强迫)(?:评分|得分|总分)?",
    "[ \\t]*[:：=]?[ \\t]*",
    "\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?[ \\t]*分[ \\t]*",
    "(?=$|[，,。；;\\n])"
  )
)

clean_model_text <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace_all(x, fixed(bad_tail), "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, diagnosis_leak_pattern, "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, scale_score_pattern, "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, scale_name_pattern, "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, bare_score_pattern, "\\1")

  x %>%
    str_replace_all("[，,；;：:、]{2,}", "；") %>%
    str_replace_all("。{2,}", "。") %>%
    str_replace_all("([。！？])\\s*[，,；;]", "\\1") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+([，,。；;：:、])", "\\1") %>%
    str_replace_all(
      "^[\\s，,。；;：:、]+|[\\s，,。；;：:、]+$",
      ""
    ) %>%
    clean_text()
}


# ==================== 7. 提取现病史及精神检查 ====================

extract_history <- function(x, old = FALSE, standardized = FALSE) {
  if (!standardized) {
    x <- keep_lines(x)

    if (old && has_text(x)) {
      x <- str_remove(
        x,
        regex(
          "^[ \\t]*现[ \\t]*病[ \\t]*史[ \\t]*[:：][ \\t]*"
        )
      )

      x <- paste0("现病史：\n", x)
    }

    x <- standardize_note(x)
  }

  parts <- split_sections(x)
  chosen <- rep(FALSE, nrow(parts))
  has_header <- any(parts$header == "现病史")

  if (has_header) {
    chosen <- parts$header == "现病史"
    source <- if (old) "structured_old" else "structured_new"

  } else {
    # 保留原有回退：
    # 无现病史标题时，使用首个其他栏目之前的正文／主诉。
    allowed <- parts$header %in% c("正文", "陪诊人", "主诉")
    stop_at <- which(!allowed)

    upto <- if (length(stop_at)) {
      stop_at[1] - 1L
    } else {
      nrow(parts)
    }

    if (upto > 0) {
      chosen[seq_len(upto)] <-
        parts$header[seq_len(upto)] %in% c("正文", "主诉")
    }

    source <- "unstructured_fallback"
  }

  # 修改：精神检查不受其所在位置限制，统一加入提取范围。
  # 使用同一个逻辑索引，保证每个段落只取一次、顺序与原文一致。
  chosen <- chosen | parts$header == "精神检查"

  history <- paste(parts$text[chosen], collapse = "\n")

  history <- str_remove(
    history,
    "^[ \\t\\n]*[:：]+[ \\t\\n]*"
  )

  removed <- if (has_text(history)) {
    str_match_all(
      history,
      inline_assessment_pattern
    )[[1]][, 3]
  } else {
    character()
  }

  cleaned_history <- remove_inline_assessment(history)

  list(
    history = cleaned_history,
    history_before_inline = history,
    assessment_removed = paste(removed, collapse = "\n"),

    chief = clean_text(
      paste(parts$text[parts$header == "主诉"], collapse = "\n")
    ),

    companion = clean_text(
      paste(parts$text[parts$header == "陪诊人"], collapse = "\n")
    ),

    source = if (has_text(cleaned_history)) source else "missing"
  )
}


# ==================== 8. 是否明确本次未到诊 ====================

is_current_absence <- function(x) {
  if (!has_text(x)) return(FALSE)

  clauses <- str_split(
    x,
    "[，,。；;！？!?\\n]+"
  )[[1]] %>%
    str_squish()

  historical <- str_detect(
    clauses,
    "上次|上回|前次|既往|曾经|此前|之前|昨日|昨天|去年|上周|上月"
  )

  current <- str_detect(
    clauses,
    "本次|此次|今日|今天|现今"
  )

  evaluable <- clauses[!historical | current]

  absence <- str_detect(
    evaluable,
    paste0(
      "(?:患儿|孩子|患者|本人)(?:今日|本次)?",
      "(?:未|没有|未能)(?:到诊|来诊|到场|在场)|",
      "未见(?:到)?患儿[ \\t]*$|",
      "^(?:本次|此次|今日|今天)?[ \\t]*(?:由)?",
      "(?:家属|父亲|母亲|父母|爸爸|妈妈)?",
      "(?:来院)?代诊[ \\t]*$"
    )
  )

  present <- str_detect(
    evaluable,
    paste0(
      "(?:患儿|孩子|患者)(?:本人)?(?:今日|本次)?",
      "(?:已|也|一同|亲自)?(?:到诊|来诊|在场)|",
      "本人(?:到诊|来诊|在场)"
    )
  )

  any(absence) && !any(present)
}


# ==================== 9. 诊断标准化及分组 ====================

clean_diagnosis <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  values <- unique(x)

  cleaned <- vapply(values, function(s) {
    if (!has_text(s)) return(NA_character_)

    s <- str_replace_all(s, "[\r\n；]+", ";")
    s <- str_replace_all(s, "[ \\t]+(?=\\d+[.、．）)])", ";")

    s <- str_replace_all(
      s,
      "([\\p{Han}])[ \\t]*(?=\\d+[.、．）)])",
      "\\1;"
    )

    pieces <- str_split(s, ";")[[1]] %>%
      str_squish()

    pieces <- str_remove(
      pieces,
      "^[（(]?[0-9０-９]+[.、．）)][ \\t]*"
    )

    pieces <- str_trim(pieces)
    pieces <- unique(pieces[nzchar(pieces)])

    if (length(pieces)) {
      paste(pieces, collapse = ";")
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)

  unname(cleaned[match(x, values)])
}

classify_diagnosis <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    !has_text(x) ~ "诊断缺失",
    x %in% PURE_DEP_LABELS ~ "单纯抑郁",
    str_detect(x, "抑郁") ~ "含抑郁但非单纯抑郁",
    TRUE ~ "非抑郁"
  )
}


# ==================== 10. 读取Excel ====================

read_input <- function(path, id_column, required_columns) {
  hdr <- read_excel(path, n_max = 1, .name_repair = "unique")
  nm <- str_squish(names(hdr))

  absent <- setdiff(required_columns, nm)

  if (length(absent)) {
    stop(
      basename(path),
      " 缺少列：",
      paste(absent, collapse = "、")
    )
  }

  types <- rep("guess", length(nm))
  types[nm == id_column] <- "text"

  ans <- read_excel(
    path,
    col_types = types,
    .name_repair = "unique"
  )

  names(ans) <- nm
  ans
}


# ==================== 11. 整理全部就诊记录 ====================

prepare_visits <- function(old, new) {
  make_rows <- function(dat, is_old) {
    if (!nrow(dat)) return(tibble())

    inputs <- as.character(
      if (is_old) dat$现病史 else dat$病历信息
    )

    unique_inputs <- unique(inputs)
    notes <- keep_lines(unique_inputs)

    if (is_old) {
      notes <- ifelse(
        has_text(notes),
        paste0(
          "现病史：\n",
          str_remove(
            notes,
            regex(
              "^[ \\t]*现[ \\t]*病[ \\t]*史[ \\t]*[:：][ \\t]*"
            )
          )
        ),
        NA_character_
      )
    }

    notes <- standardize_note(notes)

    histories <- lapply(
      notes,
      extract_history,
      old = is_old,
      standardized = TRUE
    )

    histories <- histories[match(inputs, unique_inputs)]

    get_field <- function(field) {
      vapply(histories, function(h) h[[field]], character(1))
    }

    if (is_old) {
      visit_date <- parse_date(dat$就诊日期)
      birth <- parse_date(dat$出生日期)

      valid <- !is.na(visit_date) &
        !is.na(birth) &
        visit_date >= birth

      age <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(dat))

      age[valid] <-
        year(visit_date[valid]) -
        year(birth[valid]) -
        as.integer(
          format(visit_date[valid], "%m%d") <
            format(birth[valid], "%m%d")
        )

      age[!is.na(age) & (age < 0 | age > 120)] <- NA_real_

      chief <- clean_text(dat$主诉)
      sex <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
      id <- clean_id(dat$门诊ID)

    } else {
      visit_date <- extract_note_date(inputs)
      age <- parse_age(dat$年龄)
      chief <- get_field("chief")
      sex <- normalize_sex(dat$性别)
      id <- clean_id(dat$门诊号)
    }

    history <- clean_model_text(get_field("history"))
    before <- get_field("history_before_inline")

    attend_text <- paste(
      coalesce(chief, ""),
      coalesce(get_field("companion"), ""),
      coalesce(before, ""),
      sep = "\n"
    )

    tibble(
      门诊ID = id,
      source_type = if (is_old) {
        "old_complains"
      } else {
        "new_psychosomatic"
      },

      就诊日期 = visit_date,
      年龄_病历 = age,
      性别 = sex,
      主诉 = clean_model_text(chief),
      现病史 = history,
      诊断 = clean_text(dat$诊断),
      诊断_clean = clean_diagnosis(dat$诊断),

      history_source = ifelse(
        has_text(history),
        get_field("source"),
        "missing"
      ),

      current_absence = vapply(
        attend_text,
        is_current_absence,
        logical(1)
      ),

      行内清理前病史 = before,
      行内检查删除 = get_field("assessment_removed")
    )
  }

  bind_rows(
    make_rows(old, TRUE),
    make_rows(new, FALSE)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      cmp_row_id = row_number(),

      info_score =
        1000L * has_text(现病史) +
        500L * has_text(诊断_clean) +
        200L * has_text(主诉) +
        50L * !is.na(年龄_病历) +
        20L * !is.na(性别),

      history_chars = nchar(coalesce(现病史, ""))
    )
}


# ==================== 12. 每次就诊匹配最近问卷 ====================

build_visit_candidates <- function(cmp, raw) {
  raw_candidates <- raw %>%
    group_by(ID, submit_date) %>%
    arrange(submit_time, raw_row_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      门诊ID = ID,
      raw_row_id,
      submit_time,
      submit_date,
      年龄_问卷 = parse_age(Age),
      性别_问卷 = normalize_sex(Gender)
    )

  cmp_index <- cmp %>%
    transmute(
      门诊ID,
      cmp_row_id,
      就诊日期,
      年龄_病历,
      性别,
      info_score,
      history_chars,
      pass_history = has_text(现病史),
      pass_diagnosis = has_text(诊断_clean),
      pass_attendance = !current_absence
    )

  as_tibble(
    merge(
      cmp_index,
      raw_candidates,
      by = "门诊ID",
      all = FALSE,
      sort = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      time_diff = abs(as.numeric(就诊日期 - submit_date)),
      time_diff_sort = ifelse(is.na(time_diff), Inf, time_diff)
    ) %>%
    group_by(cmp_row_id) %>%
    arrange(
      time_diff_sort,
      submit_time,
      raw_row_id,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Age = coalesce(年龄_病历, 年龄_问卷),

      Age_source = case_when(
        !is.na(年龄_病历) ~ "Medical record",
        !is.na(年龄_问卷) ~ "Questionnaire",
        TRUE ~ "Missing"
      ),

      性别 = coalesce(性别, 性别_问卷),

      pass_age =
        !is.na(Age) &
        Age >= MIN_AGE &
        Age < MAX_AGE_EXCLUSIVE,

      eligible =
        pass_history &
        pass_age &
        pass_attendance &
        pass_diagnosis
    ) %>%
    select(-time_diff_sort)
}


# ==================== 13. 每人选择最早合格病历 ====================

choose_earliest_visit <- function(candidates) {
  candidates %>%
    filter(eligible) %>%
    group_by(门诊ID) %>%
    arrange(
      is.na(就诊日期),
      就诊日期,
      desc(history_chars),
      desc(info_score),
      cmp_row_id,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      selection_status = if_else(
        is.na(就诊日期),
        "日期缺失_按病史长度优先选择",
        "最早合格的有日期病历"
      ),

      match_status = if_else(
        is.na(time_diff),
        "ID_only_date_unavailable",
        "nearest_date"
      )
    )
}


# ==================== 14. 主流程 ====================

run_preprocessing <- function() {
  dir.create(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  dir.create(
    RAW_OUTPUT_DIR,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  message("1/4 读取Excel")

  old <- read_input(
    file.path(DATA_DIR, "Complains_YoungClients.xls"),
    "门诊ID",
    c(
      "门诊ID", "就诊日期", "出生日期",
      "主诉", "现病史", "诊断"
    )
  )

  new <- read_input(
    file.path(DATA_DIR, "心身医学科精神科.xls"),
    "门诊号",
    c("门诊号", "性别", "年龄", "诊断", "病历信息")
  )

  raw <- read_input(
    file.path(DATA_DIR, "Rawdata1.xlsx"),
    "ID",
    c("ID", "提交时间", "Age", "Gender")
  )

  raw_original_cols <- names(raw)

  raw <- raw %>%
    mutate(
      ID = clean_id(ID),
      raw_row_id = row_number(),
      submit_time = parse_submit_time(提交时间),
      submit_date = as.Date(submit_time, tz = LOCAL_TZ)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ID))

  message("2/4 提取并清洗全部病史")

  cmp <- prepare_visits(old, new) %>%
    filter(!is.na(门诊ID))

  if (!all(cmp$门诊ID %in% raw$ID)) {
    stop("问卷ID未覆盖全部病历ID，请核对输入文件。")
  }

  message("3/4 选择最早合格病历及最近问卷")

  candidates <- build_visit_candidates(cmp, raw)
  selected <- choose_earliest_visit(candidates)

  other_raw <- raw %>%
    filter(!ID %in% selected$门诊ID) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    arrange(submit_time, raw_row_id, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  chosen_raw_ids <- c(
    selected$raw_row_id,
    other_raw$raw_row_id
  )

  Raw_output <- raw[
    match(chosen_raw_ids, raw$raw_row_id),
    raw_original_cols,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  Cmp_output <- selected %>%
    left_join(
      cmp %>%
        select(
          cmp_row_id, 主诉, 现病史, 诊断,
          source_type, history_source, 诊断_clean
        ),
      by = "cmp_row_id"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diagnosis_group = classify_diagnosis(诊断_clean)
    ) %>%
    select(
      门诊ID, 就诊日期, 年龄_病历, 性别,
      主诉, 现病史, 诊断,
      source_type, history_source,
      Age, Age_source,
      诊断_clean, diagnosis_group,
      submit_date, time_diff, match_status,
      selection_status, history_chars, cmp_row_id
    )

  # 保留原来的行内检查清理表。
  assessment_audit <- selected %>%
    select(cmp_row_id, 门诊ID, 就诊日期) %>%
    left_join(
      cmp %>%
        select(
          cmp_row_id,
          source_type,
          行内清理前病史,
          行内检查删除,
          现病史
        ),
      by = "cmp_row_id"
    ) %>%
    filter(has_text(行内检查删除)) %>%
    transmute(
      门诊ID,
      就诊日期,
      source_type,
      cmp_row_id,
      清理前病史 = 行内清理前病史,
      删除内容 = 行内检查删除,
      清理后现病史 = 现病史
    )

  stages <- list(
    candidates,
    filter(candidates, pass_history),
    filter(candidates, pass_history, pass_age),
    filter(candidates, pass_history, pass_age, pass_attendance),
    filter(candidates, eligible)
  )

  cleaning_summary <- data.frame(
    step = c(
      "有效ID的就诊记录",
      "清洗后病史非空",
      "年龄7-18岁",
      "排除明确本次未到诊",
      "诊断非空"
    ),

    n_visits = vapply(
      stages,
      function(z) n_distinct(z$cmp_row_id),
      integer(1)
    ),

    n_patients = vapply(
      stages,
      function(z) n_distinct(z$门诊ID),
      integer(1)
    )
  )

  cleaning_summary <- bind_rows(
    cleaning_summary,
    data.frame(
      step = "每位患者选取一份病历",
      n_visits = nrow(Cmp_output),
      n_patients = nrow(Cmp_output)
    )
  )

  diagnosis_full <- Cmp_output %>%
    count(诊断_clean, diagnosis_group, name = "n") %>%
    arrange(desc(n), 诊断_clean)

  is_dep <- str_detect(Cmp_output$诊断_clean, "抑郁")
  is_pure <- Cmp_output$诊断_clean %in% PURE_DEP_LABELS

  diagnosis_key <- data.frame(
    item = c(
      "去噪前每人一份病历",
      "仅诊断为抑郁状态",
      "仅诊断为抑郁障碍",
      "单纯抑郁合计",
      "含抑郁但非单纯抑郁",
      "不含抑郁字样"
    ),

    n = c(
      nrow(Cmp_output),
      sum(Cmp_output$诊断_clean == "抑郁状态"),
      sum(Cmp_output$诊断_clean == "抑郁障碍"),
      sum(is_pure),
      sum(is_dep & !is_pure),
      sum(!is_dep)
    )
  )

  selection_summary <- Cmp_output %>%
    count(selection_status, match_status, name = "n")

  message("4/4 保存去噪前中间数据")

  result <- list(
    Raw_output = Raw_output,
    Cmp_output = Cmp_output,
    Summary = cleaning_summary
  )

  saveRDS(
    result,
    file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Pre_denoising_state.rds")
  )

  write.xlsx(
    list(
      Summary = cleaning_summary,
      Diagnosis_key = diagnosis_key,
      Diagnosis_full = diagnosis_full,
      Selection_summary = selection_summary,
      Clean_data = Cmp_output,
      行内检查清理 = assessment_audit
    ),
    file.path(
      OUTPUT_DIR,
      "Complains_clean_step1_to_step4.xlsx"
    ),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  # 直接导出本轮Raw_output，沿用原来的输出位置。
  write.xlsx(
    Raw_output,
    file = file.path(RAW_OUTPUT_DIR, "Raw_output.xlsx"),
    rowNames = FALSE,
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  print(cleaning_summary)

  cat("\n病历选择及问卷匹配情况：\n")
  print(selection_summary)

  cat("\n诊断分组情况：\n")
  print(diagnosis_key)

  cat(
    "\n去噪前预处理完成。",
    "\n病历：", nrow(Cmp_output),
    "\n问卷：", nrow(Raw_output),
    "\n病历日期缺失：", sum(is.na(Cmp_output$就诊日期)),
    "\n年龄使用问卷补缺：",
    sum(Cmp_output$Age_source == "Questionnaire"),
    "\n存在行内检查删除的选中病历：",
    nrow(assessment_audit),
    "\n"
  )

  invisible(result)
}


# ==================== 15. 执行 ====================

preprocessing_result <- run_preprocessing()

Raw_output <- preprocessing_result$Raw_output





```




```{r}
# ============================================================
# 去噪后：输出研究数据、全部样本ML数据及人口学统计
#
# DATA：
#   Complains_denoised.xlsx
#   Pre_denoising_state.rds
#
# 分组规则：
#   单纯抑郁：诊断完整字符串为“抑郁状态”或“抑郁障碍”
#   非抑郁：诊断中不含任何“抑郁”字样
#   其余记录不进入本次ML
#
# 全部中间对象在本次运行中生成。
# 使用全部符合条件的样本，只随机分配5折。
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)


run_export <- function(base_dir = here::here(), seed = 20240211) {

  # ==================== 1. 路径及读取 ====================

  DATA_DIR <- file.path(base_dir, "DATA")
  OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(base_dir, "OUTPUT")

  dir.create(
    OUTPUT_DIR,
    recursive = TRUE,
    showWarnings = FALSE
  )

  state_file <- file.path(
    DATA_DIR, "Pre_denoising_state.rds"
  )

  denoised_file <- file.path(
    DATA_DIR, "Complains_denoised.xlsx"
  )

  state <- readRDS(state_file)

  Raw_output <- state$Raw_output %>%
    mutate(ID = str_trim(as.character(ID))) %>%
    arrange(ID, .locale = "C")

  original_cmp <- state$Cmp_output %>%
    mutate(门诊ID = str_trim(as.character(门诊ID))) %>%
    arrange(门诊ID, .locale = "C")

  # 仅回接去噪文本及删除数量。
  # 年龄、日期等其他字段沿用RDS中的原始类型。
  denoised <- read_excel(
    denoised_file,
    sheet = "Clean_data",
    col_types = "text"
  ) %>%
    transmute(
      门诊ID = str_trim(门诊ID),
      history_before = coalesce(现病史_去噪前, ""),
      history_after = coalesce(现病史, ""),
      删除片段数 = as.integer(删除片段数)
    )

  # 保证一人一份记录，且两份输入来自同一批患者。
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(Raw_output$ID),
    !anyNA(original_cmp$门诊ID),
    !anyNA(denoised$门诊ID),
    !anyDuplicated(Raw_output$ID),
    !anyDuplicated(original_cmp$门诊ID),
    !anyDuplicated(denoised$门诊ID),
    setequal(original_cmp$门诊ID, denoised$门诊ID),
    all(original_cmp$门诊ID %in% Raw_output$ID)
  )

  Cmp_step4 <- original_cmp %>%
    left_join(denoised, by = "门诊ID")

  # 确认Python处理的是对应的R预处理文本。
  stopifnot(
    all(
      coalesce(Cmp_step4$现病史, "") ==
        Cmp_step4$history_before
    )
  )

  n_before <- nrow(Cmp_step4)

  Cmp_step4 <- Cmp_step4 %>%
    mutate(
      现病史_去噪前 = history_before,
      现病史 = history_after
    ) %>%
    select(-history_before, -history_after) %>%
    filter(str_squish(现病史) != "")

  cat(
    "去噪前病历：", n_before,
    "\n排除空病史：", n_before - nrow(Cmp_step4),
    "\n去噪后有效病历：", nrow(Cmp_step4), "\n"
  )


  # ==================== 2. 定义诊断组 ====================

  pure_dep_labels <- c("抑郁状态", "抑郁障碍")

  Cmp_depression_pure <- Cmp_step4 %>%
    filter(诊断_clean %in% pure_dep_labels) %>%
    mutate(diagnosis_group = "单纯抑郁")

  Cmp_non_depression <- Cmp_step4 %>%
    filter(!str_detect(诊断_clean, "抑郁")) %>%
    mutate(diagnosis_group = "非抑郁")

  Cmp_depression_comorbid <- Cmp_step4 %>%
    filter(
      str_detect(诊断_clean, "抑郁"),
      !诊断_clean %in% pure_dep_labels
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      diagnosis_group = "含抑郁但非单纯抑郁"
    )
  
  # ==================== 3. 重新生成诊断标签及问卷 ====================

  # 每次根据本次分组重新生成，不使用环境中的旧Dep_label。
  Dep_label <- bind_rows(
    Cmp_depression_pure %>%
      transmute(
        ID = 门诊ID,
        Depression_status = "Depression"
      ),

    Cmp_non_depression %>%
      transmute(
        ID = 门诊ID,
        Depression_status = "Non-depression"
      )
  ) %>%
    arrange(ID, .locale = "C")

  Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label <- Raw_output %>%
    inner_join(Dep_label, by = "ID")

  Questionnaire_Depression_Pure <-
    Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label %>%
    filter(Depression_status == "Depression")


  # ==================== 4. 问卷计分 ====================

  # 原始条目减1；指定条目反向计分。
  # CDI不包含第26题。
  # total_DASS为7个抑郁条目的原始分之和，不乘2。

  dsrsc_items <- paste0("DSRSC", 1:18)
  phq_items <- paste0("PHQ", 1:9)

  dass_dep_items <- c(
    "DASS3", "DASS5", "DASS10",
    "DASS13", "DASS16", "DASS17", "DASS21"
  )

  cdi_items <- setdiff(
    paste0("CDI", 1:27), "CDI26"
  )

  CDI_reverse_items <- c(
    "CDI2", "CDI5", "CDI7", "CDI8", "CDI10",
    "CDI11", "CDI13", "CDI15", "CDI16",
    "CDI18", "CDI21", "CDI24", "CDI25"
  )

  DSRSC_reverse_items <- c(
    "DSRSC3", "DSRSC5", "DSRSC6", "DSRSC10",
    "DSRSC14", "DSRSC15", "DSRSC17", "DSRSC18"
  )

  score_items <- c(
    dsrsc_items,
    phq_items,
    dass_dep_items,
    cdi_items
  )

  qdat_all <- Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(score_items), as.numeric))

  # 原始问卷应无缺失；避免异常值转换成NA后被忽略计分。
  if (anyNA(qdat_all[score_items])) {
    stop("计分条目存在缺失或无法转换为数值的内容，请核对原始问卷。")
  }

  qdat_all <- qdat_all %>%
    mutate(
      across(all_of(score_items), ~ .x - 1),
      across(all_of(CDI_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x),
      across(all_of(DSRSC_reverse_items), ~ 2 - .x)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      total_DSRSC = rowSums(
        pick(all_of(dsrsc_items)), na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      total_PHQ = rowSums(
        pick(all_of(phq_items)), na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      total_CDI = rowSums(
        pick(all_of(cdi_items)), na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      total_DASS = rowSums(
        pick(all_of(dass_dep_items)), na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      ID, total_DSRSC, total_PHQ, total_CDI, total_DASS
    )


  # ==================== 5. 构建全部样本ML数据 ====================

  ml_data <- bind_rows(
    Cmp_depression_pure %>%
      transmute(
        ID = 门诊ID,
        history_text = 现病史,
        label = 1L
      ),

    Cmp_non_depression %>%
      transmute(
        ID = 门诊ID,
        history_text = 现病史,
        label = 0L
      )
  ) %>%
    inner_join(qdat_all, by = "ID") %>%
    arrange(ID, .locale = "C")

  # 确认连接问卷后没有漏掉或重复任何入组患者。
  stopifnot(
    !anyDuplicated(ml_data$ID),
    nrow(ml_data) == nrow(Dep_label),
    setequal(ml_data$ID, Dep_label$ID)
  )


  # ==================== 6. 分层分配5折 ====================

  # 固定输入顺序、随机种子及抽样算法。
  set.seed(
    seed,
    kind = "Mersenne-Twister",
    normal.kind = "Inversion",
    sample.kind = "Rejection"
  )

  ml_data <- ml_data %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    mutate(
      fold = sample(rep(1:5, length.out = n()))
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(fold, desc(label), ID, .locale = "C")


  # ==================== 7. 人口学信息 ====================

  # 年龄、性别沿用前期预处理结果：病历优先、问卷补缺。

  demo_lookup <- Cmp_step4 %>%
    transmute(
      ID = 门诊ID,
      Age = as.numeric(Age),
      sex = as.character(性别)
    )

  cleaned_demo <- demo_lookup %>%
    mutate(sample_group = "Cleaned medical records")

  pure_dep_demo <- Cmp_depression_pure %>%
    transmute(
      ID = 门诊ID,
      Age,
      sex = 性别,
      sample_group = "Pure depression medical records"
    )

  non_dep_demo <- Cmp_non_depression %>%
    transmute(
      ID = 门诊ID,
      Age,
      sex = 性别,
      sample_group = "Non-depression medical records"
    )

  questionnaire_demo <-
    Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      diagnosis_group = Depression_status,
      sample_group = "Questionnaire with diagnosis label"
    ) %>%
    left_join(demo_lookup, by = "ID")

  questionnaire_pure_demo <-
    Questionnaire_Depression_Pure %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      sample_group = "Pure depression questionnaire"
    ) %>%
    left_join(demo_lookup, by = "ID")

  ml_demo <- ml_data %>%
    transmute(
      ID,
      diagnosis_group = if_else(
        label == 1L, "Depression", "Non-depression"
      ),
      sample_group = "Full ML dataset"
    ) %>%
    left_join(demo_lookup, by = "ID")


  # ==================== 8. 人口学统计 ====================

  demo_summary <- function(dat, ...) {
    dat %>%
      group_by(...) %>%
      summarise(
        n = n(),

        age_mean = mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
        age_sd = sd(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
        age_median = median(Age, na.rm = TRUE),
        age_q1 = quantile(Age, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
        age_q3 = quantile(Age, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),

        male_n = sum(sex == "男", na.rm = TRUE),
        male_percent = male_n / n,

        female_n = sum(sex == "女", na.rm = TRUE),
        female_percent = female_n / n,

        sex_missing_n = sum(is.na(sex) | sex == ""),

        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }

  summary_samples <- bind_rows(
    cleaned_demo,
    pure_dep_demo,
    non_dep_demo,
    questionnaire_demo %>%
      select(ID, Age, sex, sample_group),
    questionnaire_pure_demo,
    ml_demo %>%
      select(ID, Age, sex, sample_group)
  ) %>%
    demo_summary(sample_group)

  summary_questionnaire_by_label <- questionnaire_demo %>%
    demo_summary(diagnosis_group)

  summary_ml_by_label <- ml_demo %>%
    demo_summary(diagnosis_group)
  
  comorbid_demo <- Cmp_depression_comorbid %>%
    transmute(
      ID = 门诊ID,
      Age = as.numeric(Age),
      sex = as.character(性别),
      sample_group = "Depression-containing non-pure medical records"
    )

  # 使用原有函数计算样本量、年龄及性别统计，
  # 加入原来的人口学汇总表。
  summary_samples <- bind_rows(
    summary_samples,
    demo_summary(comorbid_demo, sample_group)
  )

  # ==================== 9. 导出研究数据及ML数据 ====================

  export_data <- list(
    Complains_output_depression_pure =
      Cmp_depression_pure,

    Complains_output_non_depression =
      Cmp_non_depression,

    # 新增：单独导出共病补充组
    Complains_output_depression_comorbid =
      Cmp_depression_comorbid,

    Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label =
      Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label,

    Questionnaire_Depression_Pure =
      Questionnaire_Depression_Pure,

    ML_dataset_full_5fold_pure_depression =
      ml_data
  )

  for (name in names(export_data)) {
    write.xlsx(
      export_data[[name]],
      file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, paste0(name, ".xlsx")),
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }

  write.xlsx(
    list(
      Summary_samples = summary_samples,
      Questionnaire_by_label = summary_questionnaire_by_label,
      ML_by_label = summary_ml_by_label
    ),
    file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Demographic_summary_age_sex.xlsx"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )


  # ==================== 10. 保存复现信息 ====================

  # 记录输入文件指纹、随机种子和R/包版本，便于追溯。
  writeLines(
    c(
      paste0("Seed: ", seed),
      "RNG: Mersenne-Twister / Inversion / Rejection",
      "Fold ordering: ID, C locale",
      "",
      "Input file MD5:",
      capture.output(
        tools::md5sum(c(state_file, denoised_file))
      ),
      "",
      capture.output(sessionInfo())
    ),
    file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Export_run_info.txt")
  )


  # ==================== 11. 输出概况 ====================

  cat(
    "\n单纯抑郁病历：", nrow(Cmp_depression_pure),
    "\n非抑郁病历：", nrow(Cmp_non_depression),
    "\n诊断标签问卷：", nrow(Questionnaire_With_Diagnosis_Label),
    "\n含抑郁但非单纯抑郁病历：", nrow(Cmp_depression_comorbid),
    "\nML总样本：", nrow(ml_data),
    "\n其中抑郁：", sum(ml_data$label == 1L),
    "\n其中非抑郁：", sum(ml_data$label == 0L),
    "\nML抑郁比例：", round(mean(ml_data$label == 1L), 4),
    "\n"
  )

  cat("\n各fold类别数量（0=非抑郁，1=抑郁）：\n")
  print(table(ml_data$fold, ml_data$label))

  cat("\n各研究样本人口学统计：\n")
  print(summary_samples)

  cat("\nML按诊断组人口学统计：\n")
  print(summary_ml_by_label)

  cat("\n数据已导出至：", OUTPUT_DIR, "\n")

  invisible(list(
    Dep_label = Dep_label,
    ml_data = ml_data,
    Cmp_depression_comorbid = Cmp_depression_comorbid,
    summary_samples = summary_samples,
    summary_questionnaire_by_label = summary_questionnaire_by_label,
    summary_ml_by_label = summary_ml_by_label
  ))
}


# ==================== 执行 ====================

export_result <- run_export()

# export_result$summary_samples
```
